verdict.rationale: Deliverability monitoring is a fair axis for an email marketing platform, but the evidence pack never mentions bounce, complaint, or blocklist reporting, and nothing describes guidance when deliverability degrades. The only related items are generic event webhooks and a 7-day raw transactional event export. These are developer building blocks and do not name the specific signals, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see bounce, complaint, and blocklist signals per send and get actionable guidance when deliverability degrades
